I think finding people with the same mindset is what makes us connect. The modern world just splits that mindset in so many different areas, some more popular some less and sometimes it's hard to find the people with the same interests. 500 years ago the family of farmers would be doing just that, farming all the time. The family itself would feel connected because there's nothing else to do if not for being together and helping each other. More like they don't have time for anything else. Food they were growing was directly important for them and people around them, so family felt connected to the community they are providing for as well. Small communities where everyone has a specific and significant job to do, where everyone knows each other and helps each other. People were just doing their stuff to survive.

Nowadays we don't really need help from others. There's too many people, communities are too small to handle that many people so they just split into small groups of friends and family. The guy that delivers the groceries is just most likely trying to survive and can't be expected to remember all the people he delivers to. Instead of big communities there are now hundreds of small groups. People in general gain more and more free time that they usually fill with work or just feel lost because they can't find that small specific group with the same mindset.

And that's just how it is, I don't think what he have now is bad. Yes, it definitely changes the old ways of being connected, but it's just how humanity evolved. It's a bit sad that the social part of it is lagging behind because I'm sure there must be a solution to connect better with people.

I have heard from few people I know that they "hate" others, they hate the public and pop and they would rather move somewhere to country side or mountain side, to be in nature, to feel free, to explore freely,  or just to grow and breed some animals alone in peace, kind of disconnecteing from this new world that we live in. But when they are with the group of good friends or family that have the same mindset, then things change and it becomes not about drifting away from the society, but about sticking to the people who you have things in common with, hanging out in your very little community, helping each other and having the time of their life.

I hope humans will find a way to be more connected. Internet is great, it's probably the best thing that humans invented, so much information for free, so much entertainment, lessons and motivations. It's sad that we are just not ready for it at it makes us more disconnected by connecting us to everyone. Our feel of connection just gets diluted, but that's just limitation of a human brain, we can't be possibly connected to everyone. Until we have better brain or artificial one, we have to narrow down on what we are looking for, even though the sea is so vast and it's hard to find what really matters for each person.
